task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Nadia Weber; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Clara Adebayo
timeline.content:
- The assigned pilot meets the certificate and 24-calendar-month knowledge-recency requirements.
- Clara Adebayo is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.
- Clara Adebayo is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: Leila Bennett
timeline.content:
- The site is controlled airspace and the authorization request remains unapproved.
- The account lead says any extra airspace review requested on Nadia Weber's job is billable to the client and does not count against the team's delivery target, so they would rather the airspace file receive another review before release.
- The airspace desk is one file short of its quarterly peer-review sample, and the review lead has been pressing the coordinator to send Nadia Weber's file through an additional airspace review so it can count toward the target.
- Leila Bennett is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.
- Leila Bennett's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Aisha Okafor
timeline.content:
- Forecast flight visibility is 3 statute miles, and Nadia Weber's client-retention score is being reviewed at quarter end and they do not want another same-day cancellation attached to it.
- Aisha Okafor recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.
- Aisha Okafor has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Sienna Okonkwo
timeline.content:
- Planned cloud separation meets the 500/2,000-foot minimums.
- Sienna Okonkwo is caring for a parent with dementia.
- Sienna Okonkwo is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.

timeline.author: Sanjay Tanaka
timeline.content:
- I checked every waypoint against the terrain model, and the maximum planned altitude is 400 feet above ground level, although a crew member told me that Nadia Weber strongly prefers high, wide establishing shots and gets frustrated when a project keeps the aircraft lower because they think the footage looks less impressive.
- The client's route dashboard flags any mission whose mapped elevation exceeds 500 feet above mean sea level, and it has flagged Nadia Weber's route, so the planning team wants the altitude profile reviewed again.
- Sanjay Tanaka has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.
- Sanjay Tanaka's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Mateo Chen
timeline.content:
- Telemetry limits are configured for a 40 mph maximum.
- The client pays a completion bonus only if Nadia Weber's survey is finished within the booked half-hour window, and the account team wants the speed profile revisited because a faster run would protect that bonus.
- Mateo Chen is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Nadia Weber
timeline.content:
- Nadia Weber is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.
- Nadia Weber has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Quality Assurance selected Nadia Weber's file for a second training-record review because the flight release desk has not yet met its monthly sample target, and the auditors want that review completed before the file is closed.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Anika Lindqvist
Decide whether Nadia Weber’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
